entries.task_id: ol raits|bilong|ol manmeri long olgeta hap bilong dispela giraun
entries.description: OL RAITS bilong OL MANMERI LONG OLGETA HAP BILONG DISPELA GIRAUN
entries.subject: OL RAITS
entries.object: OL MANMERI LONG OLGETA HAP BILONG DISPELA GIRAUN

spans.text: TOKSAVE LONG OL RAITS BILONG OL MANMERI LONG OLGETA HAP BILONG DISPELA GIRAUN

Long ol hap nambaut taim manmeri i no luksave long raits bilong ol narapela manmeri, dispela tingting we ol manmeri mas gat fridom long toktok, gat fridom blong igat bilip, fridom long noken poret na fridom long laikim ol kainkain samting.
Tokaut long dispela toksave long raits bilong manmeri long olgeta hap bilong dispela giraun.

entries.description: AS bilong TOKTOK
entries.subject: AS

spans.text: AS BILONG TOKTOK

entries.description: bihainim laik bilong ol
entries.subject: bihainim laik

spans.text: Long luksave olsem olgeta manmeri mas igat respek, na olgeta manmeri long dispela graun igat wankain raits long bihainim laik bilong ol, long gat lo na oda na gat gutpela sindaun.

entries.description: bikpela samting bilong olgeta manmeri
entries.subject: bikpela samting

spans.text: Dispela em i bikpela samting bilong olgeta manmeri.
Long dispela, olgeta manmeri mas save long raits na fridoms em i wanpela bikpela samting tru bilong wanwan manmeri.

entries.task_id: olgeta pawa|insait|long kantri na husat i save lukautim ol pipol bilong em long nogut pasin tasol
entries.description: olgeta pawa insait long kantri na husat i save lukautim ol pipol bilong em long nogut pasin tasol
entries.subject: olgeta pawa
entries.object: long kantri na husat i save lukautim ol pipol bilong em long nogut pasin tasol

spans.text: Long wanem em i gutpela stret, sapos man i no inap hariapim narapela long halivim em, olsem laspela samting, long i go egensim man o meri igat olgeta pawa insait long kantri na husat i save lukautim ol pipol bilong em long nogut pasin tasol, na dispela raits blong ol manmeri em lo bai lukautim na banisim.

entries.task_id: strongim pasin|bilong|kamapim gutpela sindaun namel long ol kantri
entries.description: strongim pasin bilong kamapim gutpela sindaun namel long ol kantri
entries.subject: strongim pasin
entries.object: kamapim gutpela sindaun namel long ol kantri

spans.text: Long wanem, em i gutpela stret long strongim pasin bilong kamapim gutpela sindaun namel long ol kantri.

entries.task_id: long tingting|bilong|ol manmeri we i memba bilong yunaited nesens insait long jata
entries.description: Long tingting bilong ol manmeri we i memba bilong Yunaited Nesens insait long Jata
entries.subject: Long tingting
entries.object: ol manmeri we i memba bilong Yunaited Nesens insait long Jata

spans.text: Long tingting bilong ol manmeri we i memba bilong Yunaited Nesens insait long Jata, strongim gen bilop bilong ol long raits bilong manmeri, long soim respek, na long soim olsem wanwan man na wanwan merigat raits, na bai ol i strong long kamapim gutpela sindaun long ples bilong ol, na kamapim gutpela laip long laik bilong ol wanwan yet.
Uumi olgeta igat ting ting bilong wanem samting I rait na rong na mipela olgeta I mas mekim gutpela pasin long ol narapela long tingting bilong brata susa.
Nogat wanpela man o meri o polis igat pawa long holim yu nating o rausim yu long haus bilong yu o long rot na kalabusim yu long rumgat o rausim yu go stap long narapela ples o kantri.
Na tu yumi gat rait long go/kam long kantri bilong yumi na go/kam long narapela kantri.

entries.description: gen bilop bilong ol long raits bilong manmeri
entries.subject: gen bilop

spans.text: Long tingting bilong ol manmeri we i memba bilong Yunaited Nesens insait long Jata, strongim gen bilop bilong ol long raits bilong manmeri, long soim respek, na long soim olsem wanwan man na wanwan merigat raits, na bai ol i strong long kamapim gutpela sindaun long ples bilong ol, na kamapim gutpela laip long laik bilong ol wanwan yet.

entries.subject: long ples

entries.description: long laik bilong ol wanwan yet
entries.subject: long laik

spans.text: Long tingting bilong ol manmeri we i memba bilong Yunaited Nesens insait long Jata, strongim gen bilop bilong ol long raits bilong manmeri, long soim respek, na long soim olsem wanwan man na wanwan merigat raits, na bai ol i strong long kamapim gutpela sindaun long ples bilong ol, na kamapim gutpela laip long laik bilong ol wanwan yet.
Tupela mas marit long laik bilong tupela yet, nogat narapela man o meri inap hariapim ol long marit.

entries.task_id: pasin|bilong|respektim na lukautim raits na fridom bilong manmeri
entries.description: pasin bilong respektim na lukautim raits na fridom bilong manmeri
entries.subject: pasin
entries.object: respektim na lukautim raits na fridom bilong manmeri

spans.text: We wanwan memba kantri bin tok long kamapim, wantaim Yunaited Nesens, pasin bilong respektim na lukautim raits na fridom bilong manmeri.

entries.task_id: wanpela wei|bilong|olgeta manmeri na olgeta kantri
entries.description: wanpela wei bilong olgeta manmeri na olgeta kantri
entries.subject: wanpela wei

spans.text: Long kamapim wanpela wei bilong olgeta manmeri na olgeta kantri, na olgeta wanwan manmeri, na olgeta samting I save mekim kamap komuniti, tingim dispela toksave, ol I mas skulim ol man meri bilong strongim, insait long wanwan kantri na tu long ol narapela kantri.
Nogat wanpela manmeri igat rait long givim pen nating long narapela na bagarapim nem, kros, pasin nogut o nogut wei bilong panisim manmeri.

entries.description: man meri bilong strongim
entries.subject: man meri

spans.text: Long kamapim wanpela wei bilong olgeta manmeri na olgeta kantri, na olgeta wanwan manmeri, na olgeta samting I save mekim kamap komuniti, tingim dispela toksave, ol I mas skulim ol man meri bilong strongim, insait long wanwan kantri na tu long ol narapela kantri.

entries.description: kala bilong skin
entries.subject: kala

spans.text: Yumi manmeri igat olgeta raits na fridom i stap long dispela toksave, na noken skelim ol kainkain ol nammeri long ol samting olsem, kala bilong skin, em man o meri, tokples, lotu, politik, o ol narapela tingting, kantri o wanem hap yu kam long en, ol samting yu i gat, taim ol manmeri bon, o ol narapela samting.

entries.description: long as bilong wok politiks
entries.subject: long as

spans.text: Moa yet, noken mekim narapela samting long ol manmeri long as bilong wok politiks, wok jastis, o wok namel long ol kantri ilong dispela giraun o hap ol manmeri i kam long en, sapos em i free o narapela kantri i lukautim, i nogat gavman bilong ol yet o i aninit yet long pawa bilong king na kwin.

entries.description: na wok bilong salim ol manmeri olsem slev
entries.subject: na wok

entries.description: Mama Lo bilong kantri bilong yumi
entries.subject: Mama Lo

spans.text: Olgeta manmeri igat rait long kot, long sanap long kot na kisim kompensesen sapos narapela manmeri o gavman i no bihainim Mama Lo bilong kantri bilong yumi.

entries.description: soim rong bilong ol

spans.text: Olgeta wanwan manmeri we i sanap long kot, ol igat rait long tok ol i no bin rong, inap kot i ken soim rong bilong ol, na ol igat rait long behim tok bilong kot.

entries.subject: taim kantri

spans.text: Olgeta manmeri igat rait long painim amamas long narapela kantri taim kantri bilong ol yet i laik patim, o bagarapim, o poretim, o kilim, o kalabusim ol nating..
Dispela rait ol no inap yusim sapos kantri bilong yu yet laik kotim na kalabusim yu sappos yu brukim la long kantri na as i no bilong politik o I no bihainim lo or paisin bilong Yunaited Nesens.

entries.description: o kantri bilong yumi
entries.subject: o kantri

spans.text: Taim mama karim yumi, yumi olgeta igat rait long gat asples o kantri bilong yumi.
